wave_definition: Contiguous strict sign of MACD histogram; zero ends a wave. Clip all data to end date.
anchor: Same-sign wave containing June 9 final bar; only metrics visible by each wave end are computed.
first_red: First positive histogram wave beginning after June 9; not a bottom confirmation.
next_green: First negative wave following that first positive wave; a new comparison stage, not automatically dulling.

metrics.drawdown_per_interval: drawdown_pct / (bars-1); null if fewer than two bars
metrics.red_peak: maximum positive histogram in positive wave
metrics.red_sum: sum of positive histogram samples, unscaled by time; not a verified author formula

candidate: Unchanged active_reference_candidate, nearest_qualifying, two prior same-sign waves, >=2 bars; 1% locked baseline plus .75/1/1.2 and four active reference policy samples.
trend_routes: Use existing TrendChannelCalculator and fixed 2020-01-02 through 2026-08-07 fixture, clipped to 2026-07-09; freeze first upper breakout and first upward lower-edge entry separately for each 25/90 channel. No trade rules added.
falsification: Subsequent same-period software numeric alignment or author text can conflict with any event/ref/date; retain conflicts without adjusting source or thresholds.
limits: No mapping from these proxy metrics to the author dulling strength yet
No future author transcript read this turn before freeze
No production, lake or database writes
